svg.title: Latest Scriptw versus V8: elapsed time and process memory

cc:Work.dc:title: Latest Scriptw versus V8: elapsed time and process memory
cc:Work.dc:description: Latest verified Scriptw versus V8, all 17 fresh Store/Realm workloads. Measured 2026-10-26 03:30 UTC; compiler 25909ef750d487e8ae257cdce909635d64196995. Lower is better. Paired bars use a shared zero-based linear scale within each section: median elapsed milliseconds and median post-execution process RSS in MiB. RSS includes host/runtime, setup and retained warmup effects; it is not live JavaScript heap usage or a peak. Each runtime has 14 measured observations from two rounds of seven after ten warmups. Existing-Realm calls are separate. Source report SHA-256: f5f5c53db612c3a9e933abf32df969840b2a8f9393f89eb6496a7694001d3ce4. Archive SHA-256: 247e22b3216ab18cac0d5131d77d25b43ce03f070e1ace1dc3b7ae88d31f063c. sort-reverse-128.js: V8 0.019 ms, Scriptw 2.393 ms; V8 RSS 52.8 MiB, Scriptw RSS 89.1 MiB. sort-reverse-512.js: V8 0.100 ms, Scriptw 9.348 ms; V8 RSS 53.7 MiB, Scriptw RSS 98.9 MiB. sort-sorted-512.js: V8 0.103 ms, Scriptw 7.278 ms; V8 RSS 53.6 MiB, Scriptw RSS 99.1 MiB. to-sorted-512.js: V8 0.105 ms, Scriptw 7.529 ms; V8 RSS 53.7 MiB, Scriptw RSS 98.5 MiB. join-1024.js: V8 0.050 ms, Scriptw 8.678 ms; V8 RSS 53.9 MiB, Scriptw RSS 98.8 MiB. join-4096.js: V8 0.263 ms, Scriptw 34.340 ms; V8 RSS 61.3 MiB, Scriptw RSS 98.9 MiB. join-mixed-1024.js: V8 0.217 ms, Scriptw 9.269 ms; V8 RSS 59.9 MiB, Scriptw RSS 98.7 MiB. numeric-loop-10000.js: V8 0.350 ms, Scriptw 1.303 ms; V8 RSS 59.2 MiB, Scriptw RSS 80.5 MiB. numeric-loop-50000.js: V8 0.875 ms, Scriptw 4.940 ms; V8 RSS 61.1 MiB, Scriptw RSS 79.2 MiB. folded-string-4096.js: V8 0.498 ms, Scriptw 1.857 ms; V8 RSS 59.2 MiB, Scriptw RSS 82.6 MiB. dynamic-string-4096.js: V8 0.375 ms, Scriptw 3.127 ms; V8 RSS 60.7 MiB, Scriptw RSS 81.7 MiB. integer.js: V8 2.091 ms, Scriptw 5.393 ms; V8 RSS 60.0 MiB, Scriptw RSS 81.7 MiB. objects.js: V8 0.053 ms, Scriptw 4.866 ms; V8 RSS 53.9 MiB, Scriptw RSS 89.1 MiB. retained-objects.js: V8 2.723 ms, Scriptw 392.023 ms; V8 RSS 73.1 MiB, Scriptw RSS 99.7 MiB. join-empty-1024.js: V8 0.159 ms, Scriptw 2.619 ms; V8 RSS 58.5 MiB, Scriptw RSS 85.1 MiB. join-singleton-1024.js: V8 0.182 ms, Scriptw 2.731 ms; V8 RSS 59.5 MiB, Scriptw RSS 85.2 MiB. join-small-1024.js: V8 0.220 ms, Scriptw 3.629 ms; V8 RSS 60.7 MiB, Scriptw RSS 85.5 MiB.
